{{Quote|A classic! I have a recent edition in my memory banks, of course, but I’ve never recorded an original monograph.|C-3PO|<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>}}
'''''Par Ontham's Guide to Etiquette''''' was a [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsiplast]] book of social etiquette. It was also one of the most published and revised books in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]], a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and a friend of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], bought this book with the small amount of [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] prize [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] that Skywalker had given him before he left. Banai then used it to obtain a job as a [[Steward (occupation)/Legends|steward]] at the [[Three Moons (hotel)|Three Moons]]. The credits he earned eventually bought him his way to freedom.<ref name="TG" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were trying to recover the art pience ''[[Killik Twilight]]'' after it was stolen by Banai during an auction at [[Mawbo's Performance Hall]]. The search led them to the [[Banai house]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], where C-3PO recognized the book among Kitster's possessions, indicating that he had read it several times.<ref name="TG" />
